answer:
Mission Local reported that SFMTA commissioner Gwyneth Borden admitted illegally lobbying city staff on behalf of Fiorella, a restaurant that paid her $12,500. The story said she contacted planning staff and commissioners to seek support for legalizing the restaurant’s outdoor deck. She said, “I made a mistake, I should have known, I misunderstood that I shouldn't have contacted another city department at the time.”
